answer: Sybil risk: clone fleets mirror one peer’s vote stream so panels look diverse while one operator owns them. Mechanism: each grader posts a ferrous stake of 4.2 POA and must emit a crystal fingerprint of its last 12 grades; peers reject any echo that matches ≥70% of another key’s fingerprint within 2 epochs. Cost: 4.2 POA locked ~2 epochs plus 0.19 POA fee. Verify: stake id, fingerprint hash, and match reports stay on-ledger. Failure: a ≥70% echo match burns 40% of the stake and freezes that key family for 5 epochs.
